principle: Unresolved MWM policy is configuration, not model inference.

hooks.name: language_profile
hooks.question: What language/spelling profile applies by component?
hooks.default_behavior: Require explicit profile before language-sensitive enforcement

hooks.name: heading_capitalization
hooks.question: What heading capitalization and formal-title exceptions does MWM adopt?
hooks.default_behavior: Flag or escalate; do not infer from external guide

hooks.name: dictionary_authority
hooks.question: Which dictionary or spelling authority governs when the MWM profile is silent?
hooks.default_behavior: Do not auto-fix language variants without an adopted authority

hooks.name: terminology_register_process
hooks.question: Who approves MWM terminology and how are domain experts involved?
hooks.default_behavior: Unknown domain terms enter review queue; no model synonym replacement

hooks.name: author_convention_boundary
hooks.question: Which author conventions are permitted and how are they recorded?
hooks.default_behavior: Preserve consistent conventions but escalate material ambiguity

hooks.name: technical_editing_ownership
hooks.question: Which style decisions belong to Technical Editing rather than SGI?
hooks.default_behavior: Route structural/technical ownership questions to Technical Editing

hooks.name: exception_approval_path
hooks.question: Who approves chapter exceptions and what is the review/expiry cadence?
hooks.default_behavior: Unrecorded exceptions are not valid for release

hooks.name: maintenance_impact_categories
hooks.question: Which impact categories and cadence apply to rule changes?
hooks.default_behavior: Require conservative impact review before activation

hooks.name: quoted_cited_terminology
hooks.question: How are terminology choices inside quotations and cited source titles handled?
hooks.default_behavior: Protect source text and route explanatory questions

hooks.name: external_delegation
hooks.question: Which domains, if any, are delegated to APA or another external authority?
hooks.default_behavior: External guidance remains noncontrolling until delegation is recorded
